welcome.title: Welcome to your Mawaeidk dashboard
welcome.description: In about a minute you'll learn what each section does. You can skip the tour any time with the close button, and replay it from the 'Take the tour' button in the sidebar.

dashboardNav.title: Home
dashboardNav.description: Returns you to the dashboard from anywhere. The dashboard shows a quick summary of your bookings and key numbers.

dashboardStats.title: Statistics cards
dashboardStats.description: Four cards with your headline numbers: total bookings, completed, confirmed, and pending. They refresh automatically.

dashboardRecent.title: Recent bookings
dashboardRecent.description: Your five most recent bookings, newest first. Click any row to open the full detail.

bookingsNav.title: Bookings
bookingsNav.description: All your patient bookings in one place, organised by status. You'll spend most of your time here.

bookingsTabs.title: Status tabs
bookingsTabs.description: Pick which status to view: pending awaiting confirmation, confirmed ready for the visit, completed, or cancelled. The number on each tab tells you how many.

bookingsSearch.title: Search and filter
bookingsSearch.description: Search by patient name or phone, or filter by date. Useful when you have a lot of bookings.

bookingsTable.title: Bookings table
bookingsTable.description: Every booking has a row with patient name, date, time, payment method, and status. The eye icon opens detail; from there you can confirm or cancel.

doctorsNav.title: Doctors
doctorsNav.description: Manage the doctors that work under your facility. Add new doctors, edit their info, or temporarily disable them.

doctorsAdd.title: Add a doctor
doctorsAdd.description: Click here to open the new-doctor form: name, specialty, price, schedule, and a profile photo.

doctorsTable.title: Doctors list
doctorsTable.description: Each doctor has buttons for view, edit, enable/disable, and delete. Changes are reflected immediately on the patient app.

statisticsNav.title: Statistics
statisticsNav.description: Detailed reports on your performance: bookings over time, confirmation/cancellation rates, revenue. Helpful for tracking growth.

profileNav.title: Profile
profileNav.description: Edit what patients see on the Mawaeidk app: photo, description, working hours, and location on the map.

teamNav.title: Team
teamNav.description: Add team members who can sign into the panel with you. Control each member's permissions — who can manage bookings, add doctors, and so on.

settingsNav.title: Settings
settingsNav.description: Change your password, language preferences, and notification settings.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: The bell icon shows a notification every time you get a new booking. The red badge counts unread items.

relaunch.title: Replay the tour
relaunch.description: Click this button in the sidebar any time to replay this tour. Useful when a new team member joins.

done.title: All done! 🎉
done.description: You've seen every section of the panel. You can start using it with confidence. The tour button is always there in the sidebar if you need a refresher.

welcome.title: Welcome to the Mawaeidk admin panel
welcome.description: In about a minute you'll learn what each section does. Skip any time with close, or replay from the tour button in the sidebar.

usersNav.title: Customers (Patients)
usersNav.description: All patients registered in the Mawaeidk app. View their info, enable/disable accounts, or delete with extra verification.

providersNav.title: Service providers
providersNav.description: All providers (doctors/clinics/hospitals). Add a new one, edit their info, or disable an account.

bookingsNav.title: Bookings
bookingsNav.description: Every booking on the platform, split by provider type: doctor, clinic, hospital. Each has its own dedicated page.

slidersNav.title: Banners
slidersNav.description: Banners shown at the top of the home screen of the patient app. Use them for promos or seasonal announcements.

notificationsNav.title: Notifications
notificationsNav.description: Send push notifications to all patients or a specific group. Useful for maintenance windows, app updates, or flash offers.

statisticsNav.title: Statistics
statisticsNav.description: Platform-wide reports: bookings, revenue, confirm/cancel rates, monthly growth.

adminsNav.title: Admins
adminsNav.description: Manage the admin team. Add new admins, set per-admin permissions, or pause one. Each admin gets a specific permission set (view, edit, delete, ...).

settingsNav.title: Settings
settingsNav.description: General settings, medical categories, FAQs, and info pages (privacy policy, terms of service).

headerNotifications.title: System notifications
headerNotifications.description: The bell icon shows system events: bookings needing review, refund requests, or any urgent alert.

done.title: All done! 🎉
done.description: You've seen every section of the admin panel. The tour button is always there in the sidebar if you want a refresher.
